tasks.label: wait-for-server
args: for port in 3000 3001 3002 3003; do if curl -s http://localhost:$port > /dev/null; then echo "Server is ready on port $port!"; exit 0; fi; done; echo 'Waiting for server...'; sleep 2; for i in {1..30}; do for port in 3000 3001 3002 3003; do if curl -s http://localhost:$port > /dev/null; then echo "Server is ready on port $port!"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "Waiting for server... ($i/30)"; sleep 2; done; echo 'Server timeout'

tasks.label: open-chrome
args: for port in 3000 3001 3002 3003; do if curl -s http://localhost:$port > /dev/null; then echo "Opening Chrome for port $port"; open -a "Google Chrome" http://localhost:$port; exit 0; fi; done; echo 'Could not find running server'
